title: Check: Area of Parallelograms and Trapeziums (B)

questions.stem: A trapezium has parallel sides of $6\text{ cm}$ and $10\text{ cm}$, and a perpendicular height of $5\text{ cm}$. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a trapezium $= \frac{1}{2}(a + b)h = \frac{1}{2}(6 + 10) \times 5 = \frac{1}{2} \times 16 \times 5 = 40\text{ cm}^2$.
